data.name: Tamsin
data.gender_notes: Tamsin is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English tamse meaning 'tamed'. The name Tamsin is a variant of Thomasine, a feminine form of Thomas. In some sources, it is believed to mean 'Daughter of Truth'. The name Tamsin carries the meaning “Daughter of Truth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tamsin usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner truth and courage that a person holds.
data.etymology: Tamsin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter of Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tamsin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tamsin is a lesser-known variant of the common name Thomas. It embodies the virtue of a tamed or disciplined spirit, which reverberates across cultures, emphasizing self-control, stability, and maturity.
data.spiritual_significance: Tamsin means 'Daughter of Truth'. This name invites bearing the torch of truth at all times, drawing strength in the face of adversity and challenging situations, and continuously seeking wisdom, just like the character Tamsin Greene during her transformative journey in the “Grimm” series. The spiritual journey with such a name can be about embracing the truth, learning to let go of illusions, and experiencing a sense of inner peace and illumination as we awaken to the profound realities of our existence.
